arguments.code:
from collections import Counter

print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [METRIC selection frequency]: counting all artist occurrences across all recommendation pages to find least recommended</playbook_cite>')
print('<uncertainty>Not sure when show_recommendations pagination ends; will stop when a page returns an empty list</uncertainty>')

artist_counter = Counter()
page_index = 0
page_sizes = []

while True:
    recs = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index)
    if not isinstance(recs, list):
        print('unexpected_recs_type', type(recs), recs)
        break
    page_sizes.append(len(recs))
    if len(recs) == 0:
        break
    for song in recs:
        for a in song.get('artists', []):
            name = a.get('name')
            if name:
                artist_counter[name] += 1
    page_index += 1

print('pages_fetched', page_index)
print('page_sizes_first10', page_sizes[:10])
print('total_unique_artists', len(artist_counter))
print('total_artist_occurrences', sum(artist_counter.values()))

# Compute least frequency
min_freq = min(artist_counter.values()) if artist_counter else None
least = [name for name, c in artist_counter.items() if c == min_freq]
least_sorted = sorted(least)
print('min_freq', min_freq)
print('least_candidates_count', len(least_sorted))
print('least_candidates', least_sorted[:20])

selected_artist = least_sorted[0] if least_sorted else None
print('selected_artist', selected_artist)

print('<reflection>Frequency-based artist least recommended computed using all recommendation pages and artist occurrences per song</reflection>')
